body: Create lib/acp-pool.mjs exporting isAcpPoolEnabled, AcpReviewPool, and createAcpReviewPool implementing a bounded persistent stdio JSON-RPC 2.0 worker pool over agy acp (initialize, session/new, session/set_config_option, session/prompt, session/cancel) with timeout/crash respawn, clean shutdown(), and graceful { ok: false, fallback: true } degradation when AGB_ACP_POOL=0 or unavailable. Add offline fixture test/fixtures/fake-agy-acp and test/acp-pool.test.mjs. Verify: node --test test/acp-pool.test.mjs
title: Warm agy acp JSON-RPC Daemon Pool
